text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, you should eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and enough water. Regular exercise, like walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and gives you more energy. Sleep is also important, so try to get about eight hours every night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by spending time on hobbies you enjoy. Small daily habits can make a big difference, so start today and improve your life step by step.
